# LangGraph Multi-Agent State Machine Definition
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, END
from typing import TypedDict, Annotated
import operator

class AgentState(TypedDict):
    messages: Annotated[list, operator.add]
    ticker: str
    financial_ratios: dict

workflow = StateGraph(AgentState)
workflow.add_node('supervisor', supervisor_node)
workflow.add_node('sec_scraper', sec_scraper_node)
workflow.add_node('valuation', valuation_node)

workflow.set_entry_point('supervisor')
workflow.add_edge('sec_scraper', 'valuation')
workflow.add_edge('valuation', END)
app = workflow.compile()

-- Snowflake Dynamic Table Definition for Retail Analytics
CREATE OR REPLACE DYNAMIC TABLE dt_daily_store_revenue
  TARGET_LAG = '5 minutes'
  WAREHOUSE = compute_wh
AS
SELECT 
    store_id,
    date_trunc('day', transaction_time) as sale_date,
    sum(total_amount) as daily_revenue,
    count(distinct customer_id) as total_customers
FROM raw_retail_sales
GROUP BY store_id, date_trunc('day', transaction_time);
